newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia MP Short not dishonest - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia MP Short not dishonest - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Thursday Assistant Treasurer Jim Short was not deliberately dishonest in owning shares in Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and other major companies.
"I'm satisfied he's (Short) is not guilty of deliberate wrong-doing," Howard told Parliament.
"I made a decision based upon my belief that he has not in any way profited from personally," Howard said.
"He's not behaved with any deliberate dishonesty and I've decided in those circumstances not to require his resignation," he said.
The treasury portfolio, in which Short is a junior minister, includes responsibility for the banking industry.
Howard said Short had accepted the view that he had not complied with ministerial guidelines governing outside conflicting interests.
"The Assistant Treasurer did not comply with the guidelines, which he (Short) has acknowledged to the Senate."
Short said he had taken steps today to offload his 6,679 shares in ANZ and was not yet sure what the financial outcome of that sale would be.
